data.title: Trump asked Musk to lift Starlink slowdown, WSJ reports
data.summary_raw: Elon Musk, a critic of Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, had ordered the slowdown of SpaceX's Starlink, The Wall Street Journal previously reported.

data.title: Moderna shares plunge after cancer vaccine data leaks — despite positive results
data.summary_raw: Moderna released full data on its closely watched cancer vaccine developed with Merck.

data.title: Etsy bans AI-generated recipes and patterns from its online marketplace
data.summary_raw: Etsy also laid out clearer rules around AI usage on its platform, including barring sellers from creating bot-generated listings without any human involvement.

data.title: Trump defends Ramaswamy ad with Acton's estranged mom after bipartisan criticism
data.summary_raw: Ohio Gov. Mike DeWine said GOP gubernatorial nominee Vivek Ramaswamy should remove the ad featuring the mother of Democratic nominee Amy Acton.
